summary.cross_cutting_observations: The A_flat track struggles heavily with tool stability, frequently hitting malformed tool calls and limits with the SQL sub-agent. When the log retrieval tool fails, the agent systematically falls back to querying the documentation with the user's string, guessing the fault correctly, and then hallucinating specific log evidence (timestamps, exception names, latency figures) to back up its guess, leading to high root-cause scores but abysmal evidence scores. Tier 0 control cases were generally handled well if the agent managed to query basic log continuity, but tool failures in these control cases occasionally led the agent to blindly assume a fault existed.
